description: Extracts frames and arranges them into labelled contact sheets (time, frame number and the words spoken under each picture). Sample with exactly one of: `at` (list of moments), `every` (seconds), `fps`, `every_frame` (every original frame, for motion and transitions), or `around` (a phrase from the transcript; it picks the range and takes `every`, `fps` or `every_frame` with it, 4 fps by default). Work like a loupe: an overview first, then dense frames only around the moments that matter. Sheets are written to the workspace; the first ones are shown inline, open the rest by path.

around.description: A phrase from the transcript; frames are taken around it.

columns.description: Frames side by side on each contact sheet (1–8, default 4).

every_frame.description: Every original frame, with real timestamps (variable frame rate safe).

fps.description: Frames per second over the range.

rows.description: Rows of frames on each sheet (1–8, default 4); more frames go to further sheets.

source.description: The video: a link (YouTube and other sites), a path to a local file, or `inbox` for the newest file in the inbox folder.

width.description: Frame width in pixels (default 320; 240 with 6+ columns).

words.description: Put the words spoken at each frame under it.

name: frames
title: Frames and contact sheets
